action.description: Operation to perform. Valid values: update, friends, public, replies, user, direct, retweet, page, dry-run, bash, background, version, help, debug. Default is 'update'.

host.description: Target host. Valid values: twitter, custom.

logfile.description: Logfile name, relative to user's home directory (e.g., '.bti.log').

password.description: Password for the Twitter account. Not recommended for untrusted environments.

replyto.description: Status ID to link replies to.
